g.text: 1. Material HP 3D High Reusability PA 12, Multi Jet Fusion, dyed black, chemical vapor smoothing. Print roof-down (cosmetic top on the bed side, cavity open upward).
2. Minimum wall 0.8 mm by design. Recorded exceptions: the 0.525 mm strip behind each window recess (D04), the 0.5 mm aperture land with its bevel (D05),
and the feet of chamfered edges (side wall 0.7 at the rim, hood rear wall 0.681). See export/check_report.md, check 5.
3. No closed void and no cavity without a 2 mm escape path (check 6). Depowder the two camera bays, the visor openings and the Ø1.0 vent hole with care.
4. Critical-to-function: bonding plane z 5.55 (LCD), recess floor z 6.35 (cover glass), seal face z 1.2, post feet z 1.8 (all in one plane +-0.1), window recesses.
First-article inspection of these is a release gate. Nothing has been built.
5. Fit clearances are 0.25 mm nominal; the PCB-to-ledge gap is 0.15 and the window-to-recess gap 0.05 per side (D12): fit windows to the printed recess.
